description: Compare two Python implementations side-by-side to identify optimizations. Open pipelines/traditional_pipeline.py and pipelines/functional_pipeline.py in split editor view (use Ctrl+\ to split). Compare the implementations and create a file called 'comparison_notes.txt' in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace) documenting the key optimization present in the functional version (hint: look for performance-related decorators or caching mechanisms). The comparison_notes.txt file should describe what optimization technique is used in functional_pipeline.py that is not in traditional_pipeline.py.
